proposals.title: Overdue rule for open tasks
proposals.change: Add a TaskPresenter class to the Browser page component (DSN-003) with isOverdue(task, todayLocal): boolean. It returns true only when done is false, dueDate is not null and dueDate is before the user's local YYYY-MM-DD date. Done tasks, tasks without a due date and tasks due today or later return false. Add a message in SEQ-001 where the page calls it for each task.

proposals.title: Visible done and overdue rendering
proposals.change: Add a renderTask(task, isOverdue) method to the Browser page's TaskPresenter. It shows a ticked checkbox with struck-through text for done tasks and an empty checkbox with plain text for open tasks, and adds an overdue marker when isOverdue is true. Add a re-render message to SEQ-003 after the PATCH response, which also covers unticking a task whose due date is past.
